I've liked this gallery so much that I've translated it (I will upload it eventually) and I've created this small remix/alt end to it. I hope the quality is good enough for an upload here, as I've created this for myself but maybe you may enjoy it as well!

If you know more similar galleries that need a translation/alt end, let me know!
n: [Doujinshi] [ht25f][Forest Caravan (Forest)] Alt end for the female hero is completely unaware that she was utterly defeated by the Demon King!
